media:group.media:title: Wingsuiting Through Mountain Traffic
media:group.media:description:
Wingsuit World Champion Espen Fadnes @ESPNF takes flight above Åndalsnes, Norway, with one target in mind: Trollstigen Road, a winding mountain road with only 10% grade, where fellow wingsuit pilot and world-record holder Amber Forte @amber_forte is out for a casual bike ride.
Exiting from an elevation of over 5,000 feet, Espen accelerates across the valley, reaching speeds of 113 MPH before flying past Amber on the road below. Captured in stunning 8K on our 360 camera, GoPro MAX2.

entry.title: Fighting a House Fire | GoPro POV

media:group.media:title: Fighting a House Fire | GoPro POV
media:group.media:description:
Step inside a firefighter's POV with first responder William Meza. This uncut footage, captured on his GoPro HERO12 Black, puts you on the scene as the crew arrives and works to put out the fire. Filmed in real time, this is what it looks like when a firefighting crew goes to work.
Per @redcross if a fire occurs in your home, get out, stay out + call for help.
